rows.name: Fire
rows.note: Ignite: fixed 5 s duration in the effect; its own burn tick reads Data.Damage, which mods can't set, so the burn damage is dealt by the mod. Verified: flames show on the enemy.

rows.name: Lightning
rows.note: Shock: duration and CritChanceResistanceModifier are SetByCaller; swapped to fixed values on the effect's default object for the call. No Lightning damage attribute exists, so only AllElementDamageModifier scales it.
